confidence_bands.certain: Exact source-verified evidence; maps to anchored or shifted.
confidence_bands.probable: Independent revision and structural evidence agree, or one source has a decisive margin; maps to fuzzy.
confidence_bands.ambiguous: Evidence sources disagree without a decisive margin.
confidence_bands.orphaned: Structural deletion evidence outweighs weak projection evidence.

notes: Exact revision projections retain the fast path; only edited anchors pay for cross-evidence calibration.
Agreeing scores use a conservative average plus a small agreement bonus rather than assuming statistical independence.
The calibration API and confidence-band types are exported from both Node and browser entrypoints.
Timing is informational and is not used as a deterministic regression gate.
